SiteGroups.GroupDescription: Websites sharing the same group are listed together in the website selector and in the All Websites dashboard. Pick an existing group or type a new one, leave empty to keep this website ungrouped.

SiteGroups.ToggleGroup: Show or hide the websites of the group %s
